body:
Same template, same reader, one more gap, 2026-10-25T14:15Z: the `auth.invitation` mail never says when the link expires.

- `plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts:341-388`: the variables (:353-367) are inviter / organization / role / acceptUrl / appName. There is **no expiry variable**.
- The sender, `plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts:614-626`, has `invitation.expiresAt` in hand and does not pass it.
- The window is better-auth's organization-plugin default (48 h; measured `sys_invitation.expires_at` = created + 2 days). Neither objectstack nor cloud sets `invitationExpiresIn`.

So an invitation opened on day 3 dies at the accept page with no warning in the mail. Suggest folding it into the same PR: pass `expiresAt` and render 「此邀请将于 {date} 过期」 / "This invitation expires on {date}" in each locale body. Measured on the 2026-10-25 local E2E (cloud `36b07fdf`, framework pin `888d686`).
